column1: ## HISTORY. Rated 2026-08-12 on criteria fixed in writing BEFORE any input was
## run: 23 PASS / 12 PARTIAL / 15 FAIL. The 2026-08-13 "fix it all" round then
## worked the defect clusters; the ratings below are the CURRENT state:
## >>> THESE 50 INPUTS ARE NO LONGER UNSEEN. <<<
## The engine has now been tuned against them, so this file measures
## regression, not generalisation — exactly the memorisation trap the README
## warns about. The next generalisation number needs a FRESH set of inputs
## nobody has parsed yet. Do not quote the tally below as a generalisation
##   PASS     everything present AND correctly structured
##   PARTIAL  broadly right; something lost or mis-shaped
##   FAIL     the output misrepresents the input
## Judged on DEFAULT mode; `multi` records whether --multi differs.
## Self-assessment by the agent that wrote the engine: a screen, not a verdict.
